conditionalGenericCall.callee: an existing same-module definition with one type parameter and one value parameter; its complete conditional parameter and return structures match the caller
conditionalGenericCall.caller: top-level call with one direct parameter 0 value argument and one explicit bound parameter 0 type argument; preserve existing complete call and argument origins
conditionalGenericCall.identity: package7/profile-v7 and private concreteHIR7; existing definition, instance, linkage and HIR input algorithms remain v1; old6 and mixed profiles reject
conditionalGenericCall.limits: same-signature multi-hop calls and ordinary/self/mutual recursion are admitted; each definition is validated once and each concrete instance is queued once; nested calls, concrete or inferred type arguments, mixed conditional/indexed signatures and unsupported expression forms remain rejected
conditionalGenericCall.scope: definition return expression only when caller parameter and return are the same complete conditional signature
conditionalGenericCall.typing: fresh official checker and existing mapper determine actual caller/callee scalar signatures, complete call instance closure and parameter forwarding; no host conditional evaluation or fabricated successful facts

conditionalSignature.body: one type parameter and one value parameter with identical complete conditional parameter and return types; direct return of parameter 0 or the finite explicit conditionalGenericCall below; no number-add body
conditionalSignature.checkType: direct bound type parameter in the current definition
conditionalSignature.fields: conditional requires all four child fields and parameter 0; scalar and parameter leaves omit all four fields; no null or extra fields
conditionalSignature.scope: definition parameter and return signatures only; root type arguments remain concrete boolean or number; direct-call type arguments remain boolean, number or bound parameter
conditionalSignature.typing: official ConditionalTypeNode with syntax-only parameter-leaf substitution; fresh official checker and existing mapper determine bool or f64; no host branch selection

mappedIndexedGenericCall.callee: an existing same-module definition with one type parameter and one value parameter; its complete indexed parameter and return structures exactly match the caller, including the mapped binder text, key occurrences/order, mapped value and separate index syntax
mappedIndexedGenericCall.caller: top-level call with one direct parameter 0 value argument and one explicit bound outer parameter 0 type argument; preserve existing complete call and argument origins
mappedIndexedGenericCall.identity: package7/profile-v7 and private concreteHIR7; existing definition, instance, linkage and HIR input algorithms remain v1; old6 and mixed profiles reject
mappedIndexedGenericCall.limits: same-signature multi-hop calls and ordinary/self/mutual recursion are admitted; each definition is validated once and each concrete instance is queued once; nested calls, concrete or inferred type arguments, mixed conditional/indexed signatures and unsupported expression forms remain rejected
mappedIndexedGenericCall.scope: definition return expression only when caller parameter and return are the same complete indexed signature
mappedIndexedGenericCall.typing: fresh official checker and existing mapper determine actual caller/callee scalar signatures, complete call instance closure and parameter forwarding; no host key selection, mapped evaluation or fabricated successful facts

mappedIndexedSignature.body: one type parameter and one value parameter with identical complete indexed parameter and return types; direct return of parameter 0 or the finite explicit mappedIndexedGenericCall below; no number-add body
mappedIndexedSignature.fields: mapped and indexed nodes require parameter 0 and exactly their matching nonnull wrapper; other type kinds omit both wrappers; conditional children and mapped/indexed wrappers are mutually exclusive; no null or extra fields
mappedIndexedSignature.index: string-literal or union under the same key policy; each literal belongs to the mapped key domain; record the complete index syntax, never a selected-key replacement
mappedIndexedSignature.keys: string-literal has exactly one literal; union preserves source order and all 2..16 literal occurrences including duplicates; each literal is valid Unicode scalar text without NUL, may be empty, and is at most 256 UTF8 bytes
mappedIndexedSignature.mapped: only the direct indexed object may be mapped; binder is a bounded nonempty owned name distinct from the outer type parameter; its symbol is independent; no readonly, optional, remapping, members, nested mapped or binder-dependent value
mappedIndexedSignature.scope: definition parameter and return signatures only; root type arguments remain concrete boolean or number; direct-call type arguments remain boolean, number or bound parameter
mappedIndexedSignature.typing: official MappedTypeNode and IndexedAccessTypeNode with owned literal or union keys and syntax-only outer-parameter-leaf substitution; fresh official checker and existing mapper determine bool or f64; no host key selection or mapped-type evaluation
mappedIndexedSignature.value: boolean, number or the sole bound outer type parameter leaf; no conditional, mapped, indexed or inner-binder value

numberAdd.operands: exactly two ordered direct bound parameters declared number; child origins contained by the add origin; no nested addition or literals
numberAdd.result: official number and fresh mapped f64; no host arithmetic
